arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

LOG_FILE="/var/log/dummy.log"
LEVELS=("INFO" "DEBUG" "WARN" "ERROR")
MESSAGES=(
  "Request received: GET /api/health"
  "Request received: POST /api/data"
  "Response sent: 200 OK"
  "Response sent: 500 Internal Server Error"
  "Database query executed in ${RANDOM}ms"
  "Cache miss for key: user_$(( RANDOM % 9999 ))"
  "Cache hit for key: session_$(( RANDOM % 9999 ))"
  "Connection pool size: $(( RANDOM % 50 + 1 ))"
  "Scheduled job triggered: sync_data"
  "Memory usage: $(( RANDOM % 40 + 60 ))%"
  "CPU spike detected: $(( RANDOM % 30 + 70 ))%"
  "New user registered: user_$(( RANDOM % 9999 ))"
  "Token expired for session_$(( RANDOM % 9999 ))"
  "Retry attempt $(( RANDOM % 3 + 1 ))/3 for failed request"
  "Disk I/O wait: $(( RANDOM % 20 ))ms"
  "Config reloaded successfully"
  "Outbound webhook dispatched to https://hooks.example.com"
  "Rate limit reached for IP: 192.168.$(( RANDOM % 255 )).$(( RANDOM % 255 ))"
  "Garbage collection: freed $(( RANDOM % 256 ))MB"
  "Health check passed: all systems nominal"
)

echo "Starting log appender → writing to $LOG_FILE (Ctrl+C to stop)"

while true; do
  LEVEL=${LEVELS[$RANDOM % ${#LEVELS[@]}]}
  MSG=${MESSAGES[$RANDOM % ${#MESSAGES[@]}]}
  TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
  # Pad level for alignment
  printf "%s %-5s %s\n" "$TIMESTAMP" "$LEVEL" "$MSG" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep $(awk 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f\n", rand() * 2 + 0.5 }')
done

400GB free — we're not going anywhere near zero naturally. I'll run the append script in the background and monitor disk usage, stopping it if available space hits zero.

arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

LOG_FILE="/var/log/dummy.log"
MONITOR_PATH="/var/log"
APPENDER_SCRIPT="/var/log/append_random.sh"
MONITOR_LOG="/var/log/disk_monitor.log"

# Start the appender in the background
bash "$APPENDER_SCRIPT" &
APPENDER_PID=$!
echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Appender started (PID=$APPENDER_PID)" | tee -a "$MONITOR_LOG"
echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Monitoring disk usage on $MONITOR_PATH..." | tee -a "$MONITOR_LOG"

cleanup() {
  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Caught signal — stopping appender (PID=$APPENDER_PID)..." | tee -a "$MONITOR_LOG"
  kill "$APPENDER_PID" 2>/dev/null
  exit 0
}
trap cleanup SIGINT SIGTERM

while true; do
  AVAIL_KB=$(df --output=avail "$MONITOR_PATH" | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')
  AVAIL_HUMAN=$(df -h --output=avail "$MONITOR_PATH" | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')
  USED_PCT=$(df --output=pcent "$MONITOR_PATH" | tail -1 | tr -d ' %')

  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Disk available: ${AVAIL_HUMAN} (${USED_PCT}% used)" | tee -a "$MONITOR_LOG"

  if [ "$AVAIL_KB" -le 0 ]; then
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] ⚠️  DISK FULL! Available space is zero. Stopping appender." | tee -a "$MONITOR_LOG"
    kill "$APPENDER_PID" 2>/dev/null
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Appender stopped. Monitor exiting." | tee -a "$MONITOR_LOG"
    exit 1
  fi

  sleep 5
done
